description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [ATK and MND +30%, DEF and RES +25% (25s)] to all allies, grants [Attach Water with Stacking], [Awoken Water], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Beg For Your Life Mode] to the user

description.name: Attach Water with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Water Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Water 3

description.name: Awoken Water
description.text: Water abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Water abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Beg For Your Life Mode
description.text: Casts I'll Hit You! after another ally casts a Spellblade ability, removed after triggering five times
